trans-unit.source: 一、申报时间为2026年6月1日至2026年7月15日，逾期不再受理。项目代号为，请务必在申报表中保持一致。
trans-unit.target: (1) Applications are accepted from June 1, 2026 to July 15, 2026; late submissions are not accepted. The project code is , and must be kept identical in the application form.

trans-unit.source: 二、申报单位须具备独立法人资格，并提供近三年的科研项目清单。清单中的项目代号须与申报书封面完全相同，不得自行简写或改写。
trans-unit.target: (2) Applicants must be independently registered legal entities and must provide a list of research projects from the past three years. Codes in the list must match the cover of the application exactly; abbreviations or rewrites are not permitted.

source.g: 三、每个申报单位最多申报两个项目；
超过限额的申报材料不予受理，且不另行通知。

target.g: Applications exceeding the limit will not be accepted, without further notice.
(3) Each applicant may submit at most two projects;

trans-unit.source: 各有关单位：现将2026年度科研合作项目申报事项通告如下。
trans-unit.target: To all relevant units: the 2026 research cooperation project application arrangements are set out below.
